¡Bienvenidos al primer campeonato oficial de Quilmes!
Este torneo es el **número 100** en la historia de Argentina. ¡Gracias por acompañarnos todo este tiempo!

**POR FAVOR LEER LAS PESTAÑAS ["IMPORTANTE"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/QuilmesAleatorio2025#57139-importante-important) Y ["PAGO"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/QuilmesAleatorio2025#57140-pago-payment) PARA REALIZAR EL REGISTRO CORRECTAMENTE.**

---

Welcome to the first official competition in Quilmes!
This is the **100th** competition in Argentina's history. Thanks for being part of this!

**PLEASE READ THE ["IMPORTANT"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/QuilmesAleatorio2025#57139-importante-important) AND ["PAYMENT"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/QuilmesAleatorio2025#57140-pago-payment) TABS IN ORDER TO REGISTER SUCCESSFULLY.**

items.name: Cubing Comes to Madurai 2025

venue.name: Shree Subitcham Mahal
venue.address: Shree Subitcham Mahal, Appanthirupathi, Tamil Nadu 625301

items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NzUxMDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--8999453063b90681d9412d33d5ab416934ec954e/Madurai%20Cube%20Open%202025.jpg)
Please **review all of the tabs listed on this website.**
​
* The events will happen in the order listed on the "[Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CubingComestoMadurai2025#competition-schedule)" tab, but event durations are tentative! Check back the day before the competition, as event durations may change depending on the number of competitors in events.
​
* You only need to show up for the events that you're competing in - but we encourage you to show up before schedule time/stay after schedule time. Do note that we may run ahead of or behind schedule, particularly for events in the afternoon please be ready at least 30 minutes in advance just in case
​
* We won't be allowing late entry in the competition under any exceptions. Make sure you will be available at the venue when your name is called.
​
* Make sure you go through all the WCA regulations.
​
* Kindly bring your ID card while entering the campus.
​
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or unaware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session.
​
* Participants must bring their own cubes.

venue.name: [大田区民プラザ](https://www.ota-bunka.or.jp/facilities/plaza/halls/exhibition)
venue.address: 3-1-3 Shimomaruko, Ota, Tokyo (東京都大田区下丸子3-1-3) 〒146-0092

items.information:
### WCAシリーズ大会
「Tokyo Spring AM 2025/Tokyo Spring PM 2025」はWCAシリーズ大会です。
WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち一つにのみ参加できます。
複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけが考慮され、その他は無効となります。

このページは「Tokyo Spring PM 2025」のページです。

主催：くるくる会
https://kurukurukai.com

### WCA Series Competitions
Tokyo Spring AM 2025/Tokyo Spring PM 2025 are recongnized as WCA series competitions.
WCA series competitions are a series of multiple competitions. You can participate in only one of them.
If you register for more than one competition in a series, only the earliest registration will be valid, and the others will be invalid.

This page is for Tokyo Spring PM 2025.

Organized by Kurukurukai.
https://kurukurukai.com

items.name: UCLA Spring 2025
items.information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCLASpring2025#55412-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png)

### UCLA Students
If you are a UCLA Student or Faculty member, your registration fee for this competition will be waived. Register for the competition without paying, and contact the [organization team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=UCLASpring2025&contactRecipient=competition) with your credentials (such as a student ID) attached. Your registration will be accepted in the order in which this email is received.
